title: Incident and breach notification

statement.en: A participant or operator that detects a security incident affecting shared data or data space services shall notify the operator and the affected participants without undue delay and at the latest within the period set at Level 1, shall record the incident and the remedial actions taken, and shall cooperate in the investigation. Where personal data are affected, the legal notification duties apply in addition.

control: Incident register exists and each entry shows notification time, recipients and remedial action
trustFramework: none; suspension of a participant following an incident is handled under the trust framework

expressions.note: An incident ticket schema can be added where the data space operates a helpdesk.

source: Sitra rulebook model, General Terms and Conditions
